capabilities: keep a custom distance of context before and after the cursor
set the offset as a fixed pixel distance or relative to the content-area height
clamp the offset when it exceeds half of the content area
extras: README includes manual installation steps and notes that offsets larger than half the content area are capped because of the cursor height.
problem: By default Obsidian lets the cursor run to the top or bottom edge of the view, removing surrounding context while editing.

relations.evidence: just like scrolloff in vim or cursor surrounding lines in VS-Code
just like scrolloff in vim or cursor surrounding lines in VS-Code

summary: Editor plugin that keeps a fixed or relative distance of context above and below the cursor while scrolling, like vim's scrolloff.
